consequence.statement: Existing ClusterExternalSecret objects remain stored as v1beta1 until rewritten; a storage version migration (re-write all objects) and update of status.storedVersions must be done before a later release removes v1beta1.
consequence.remediation: Re-write all ClusterExternalSecret objects and update status.storedVersions on the CRD to drop v1beta1.

assertion.statement: The storage version of the clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io CRD moves from v1beta1 to v1 (v1beta1 storage true → false); existing objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten, so a storage version migration is needed before a later release removes v1beta1.
